$comment: SST v3 component -> diagrams-js node id (provider/category/Name). Verified against the pinned diagrams-js by tests/mappings.test.ts. 'cluster' rows become clusters, not nodes. 'hidden' components are omitted unless the request asks for them.

sst.aws.Nextjs.note: one node for the whole site (CloudFront + Lambda + S3 underneath)

sst.aws.Router.note: routes become edges from the router to each target

sst.aws.Cron.note: label with the schedule, e.g. 'cron: rate(1 hour)'

sst.aws.Auth.note: OpenAuth issuer runs on Lambda; label 'Auth (OpenAuth)'

sst.aws.CognitoIdentityPool.note: merge into the user pool node unless both matter

sst.aws.ApiGatewayV2.note: label 'API (HTTP)'; each route becomes an edge to its handler

sst.aws.Service.note: ECS service on Fargate; add aws/network/ALB in front when it has loadBalancer

sst.cloudflare.*.note: Kv, D1, Bucket (R2), Queue, DurableObject, Hyperdrive, Ai, Cron, Workflow, StaticSite, SsrSite, Astro, ReactRouter, TanStackStart: one Cloudflare node each, label '<Component>: <name>'

external-service.note: for sst.Linkable or env vars that point at a SaaS: prefer a saas/* icon (Stripe, Auth0, Slack, Twilio, Cloudflare, Datadog, Sentry) when one exists; see find-node

sst.aws.Vpc.label: VPC <name>
sst.aws.Vpc.note: put Postgres/Aurora/Redis/Efs/Service/Cluster and vpc-attached Functions inside

sst.aws.Cluster.label: ECS cluster <name>
sst.aws.Cluster.note: contains its Services and Tasks; nest inside the Vpc cluster

hidden: sst.Linkable (unless it stands for an external service)
sst.aws.Dns / sst.cloudflare.Dns / sst.vercel.DnsAdapter (show aws/network/Route53 only when a custom domain matters to the reader)
